title: Introduction to Node.js
author: John Doe
content: Node.js is a powerful JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine. It allows developers to build scalable network applications using JavaScript on the server side.

title: Understanding Express.js
author: Jane Smith
content: Express.js is a minimal and flexible Node.js web application framework that provides a robust set of features for web and mobile applications.

title: MVC Pattern in Web Development
author: Bob Johnson
content: The Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern is an architectural pattern that separates an application into three main logical components: the model, the view, and the controller.
